dormants.name: Overgrown Arch
dormants.journal: The arch shed its moss overnight. Under it, the air feels older than the forest.

dormants.name: Still Stone
dormants.journal: The still stone was a wellhead all along. There is water at the bottom, and it is clear.

dormants.name: Sealed Hollow
dormants.journal: The hollow opened while I was away. Something small had been keeping house inside.
